sentences.text:
KAILASH CHAND JAIN S/O KHEMCHAND JAIN, AGED ABOUT 71 YEARS, SHADORA,DISTT.ASHOK NAGAR (MADHYA PRADESH)
 .....PETITIONER (NONE FOR THE PETITIONER)

AND STATE OF M.P. TH:FOOD INSPECTOR,DEPUTY DERICTOR FOOD AND DRUGS ADMINISTRATION GUNA (MADHYA PRADESH)
 .....RESPONDENT (MR. SUSHANT TIWARI - PUBLIC PROSECUTOR)

Th is revision coming on for hearing this day, th e court passed the following:
 ORDER As per PUD dated 14.11.2022 received from Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ashoknagar it appears that sole petitioner - Kailash Chandra has died on 30.09.2021.
PUD is supported by the report of arrest warrant and death certificate.

In view of death of the petitioner, this criminal revision filed against the judgment dated 12.11.2010 passed in Criminal Appeal No.43/2010 by First Additional Sessions Judge, Ashoknagar, affirming the conviction and sentence, as recorded by JMFC, Ashoknagar in Criminal Case 826/2004 under Section 16(1)(Ka)(1) of Prevention of Food and Adulteration Act, 1954 has become abated.
